messages:
Alix: Heads up — saw a spike of `apiserver` 503s in us-east1 starting ~10:12 UTC, coincident with a large GPU attach wave (several RTX pools). stack traces show lots of watch reconnects and 5xx responses.
Jamal: link to grafana? pinging control plane team
Alix: https://grafana.internal/redwood/apiserver — 10:12 sharp CPU/latency spike on kube-apiserver instances + increased leader election churn on controller-manager
sre-bot: [ALERT] apiserver.high_error_rate us-east1 — 10:13 UTC — 503 spike
Rachel: any recent rollout or kubeconfig change? deployment events?
Alix: no rollout. Autoscaler started attaching ~40 GPU nodes in a 3m window. I think kubelet churn + network rebalancing caused a fanout.
Lucas: seeing etctd leader transfer logs around same time: `raft: leader changed from 10.2.1.5 to 10.2.3.8` repeated a few times
Maya: could be MTU/fragmentation on the new nodes' subnet. We saw similar with jumbo frames last quarter.
Jamal: can we confirm etcd peer latencies? grabbing `etcdctl endpoint status --write-out=table`
Alix: pasted snippet from apiserver logs:
```
E0319 10:12:31.123 server.go:123] unable to handle watch: watch timed out: etcdserver: request timed out
E0319 10:12:31.456 handlers.go:89] http2: stream closed
```
Rachel: controller-manager is also logging: `error retrieving resource lock kube-system/controller-manager: timed out` — that explains reconcile backlog
Lucas: immediate mitigation options:
- throttle attaches (pause autoscaler)
- reduce kube-apiserver max-inflight? (affects latency for clients)
- increase etcd election timeout temporarily
Maya: seconding pause autoscaler. we can also temporarily pin control plane to stable subnets and avoid new ENIs
Jamal: paused node attach job in us-east1 via infra job: `jobs/attach-gpu-wave` -> paused at 10:16
deploy-bot: Pause applied to jobs/attach-gpu-wave by Jamal (run_id=9876)
Alix: dropping a small script to clear watcher backlog and restart controllers gracefully? prefer non-disruptive first
Rachel: I'd rather rotate kube-apiserver one at a time with `--etcd-servers-overrides` increase? or bump `--leader-elect-lease-duration` on controller-manager from 15s to 30s temporarily
Lucas: +1 to lease bump. also bump etcd `--election-timeout` on followers to 5s -> 10s? (need coordinate)
Maya: network team + infra: check if any NAT gateways spiked or route table churn. attaching traceroute from one new node to etcd:
```
traceroute to 10.2.1.5 (10.2.1.5), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1 10.0.0.1 1.2 ms
 2 10.10.50.1 5.3 ms
 3 10.2.1.5 25.6 ms
```
Maya: no obvious drop but p90 increased
Jamal: ok doing coordinated steps now:
1) keep attach paused
2) bump controller-manager lease to 30s via configmap rollout (canary one pod now)
3) increase etcd election timeout on one follower and monitor
Alix: after bump, apiserver errors drop within 90s — post-change metrics look better (confirmed by grafana)
Rachel: controller backlog decaying, controllers reconciling successfully again
sre-bot: [RESOLVED] apiserver.high_error_rate us-east1 — incident auto-closed at 10:24 UTC
Maya: follow-ups: network team to validate MTU settings on GPU subnets; infra to add rate-limiter on attach waves to avoid fanout; ops to add playbook entry for etctd/election tuning
Lucas: cost note — rate-limiting attaches could increase warm pool costs for Dedicated, flagging to finance
Alix: opened postmortem ticket: PM-1123 with timeline and mitigation steps
Jamal: thanks all, monitoring for 30m then will unpause attach if stable :thumbsup:
Maya: FYI will run a smoke test on a small attach batch tomorrow at 03:00 UTC on canary region
Rachel: adding controller-manager lease increase to runbook with rollback steps
Alix: great work, thanks :heart:
